headline: India Pledges $1.62 Billion Economic Aid Package to Flood-Damaged Nepal
summary: India announced a financial package of 240 billion Nepalese rupees ($1.62 billion) to assist Nepal in rebuilding infrastructure following severe flood damage.
why: Bilateral aid flows from India to Nepal support South Asian regional economic integration and infrastructure reconstruction.

impacts.name: Nepal
impacts.why: Nepal received a $1.62 billion financial package from India for flood recovery efforts.
